sourceBindings.text: For the source's 40-minute practical block and 5-minute discussion, Part 1 is a proposed 20 minutes for PPE, sample inspection, learner pH and texture setup; Part 2 proposes 20 minutes for receiving supplied OM/P/K data, interpretation and report writing. The trainer releases the supplied data after physical measurements. The source acknowledges roughly 24 hours for full jar settling: a new jar that has settled only 15–20 minutes cannot automatically give final sand/silt/clay percentages. Document its provisional layers and return after the validated settling interval, or compare with a clearly labelled pre-settled reference jar of the same soil without claiming its readings as your own.

units.delivery: Explain calmly and naturally to agricultural vocational learners in clear English. Read only the supplied connected passage with natural pauses. Preserve all negations, conditions, scene-safety restrictions and limits of training. Do not add medical advice, diagnoses, character voices, an introduction, music or an extra summary.
